title: Make Signup button functional with submit, validation, and UI-only success feedback

requirements.summary: Convert the Signup CTA into a real form submission that runs a submit handler and never behaves like a dead button (UI-only).
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Signup" triggers a submit handler (e.g., form onSubmit) and prevents default page reload behavior.
No backend logic is added (no actor calls, no external services).

file_operations.description: Wrap the signup inputs in a <form> with an onSubmit handler that calls preventDefault; change the green "Signup" button to type="submit" and remove the current no-op click handler so the CTA always triggers form submission in draft mode (UI-only). Use existing shadcn-ui Button/Input/Select components for the form controls; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required-field validation on submit with inline, field-specific error messages that clear/update as users fix inputs and re-submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting with missing required fields displays inline, field-specific error text in English (no generic silent failure).
Errors are cleared/updated appropriately when the user fixes inputs and re-submits.
If Relation is "Other", the custom relation text input is validated as required and shows an inline error when empty.
Password and Confirm Password are validated so that missing values and mismatches show inline errors.

file_operations.description: Implement a submit-time validation function that checks all UI-required fields (at minimum: Profile Photo, Relation, Age, Mobile Number) plus signup-critical fields (Email, Password, Confirm Password) and sets the existing errors state with per-field messages. Add inline error rendering next to any fields that currently lack it (e.g., email/password/confirm/customRelation/profileImage/name if treated as required), and add onChange/onValueChange handlers that clear the specific field error when the user edits that field. Use existing shadcn-ui Input/Select/Label components for consistent inline error placement; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: When validation passes, show a clear UI-only success confirmation and provide a working next action (Back to Login).
acceptanceCriteria: When all required fields are valid, the user sees a clear English success confirmation (e.g., "Signup successful / Pending approval").
Success behavior does not add any backend logic or paid services.
After success, the user has an obvious next action (e.g., a "Back to Login" button) that works.

file_operations.description: Add a local success state (e.g., isSubmitted/isSuccess). If submit validation passes, switch the Signup screen UI to a simple success view or show a prominent success message on the Signup screen. Prefer using the existing shadcn-ui Alert component for the success confirmation text (e.g., "Signup successful / Pending approval") and include a "Back to Login" Button wired to onNavigateToLogin. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
